You read one Project Zero blog post and list the exploitation techniques it explains.

For each technique give:
- slug: a short kebab-case name for the technique itself, not for this post, so the same technique in two posts gets the same slug (for example "heap-grooming" or "type-confusion-to-rw");
- name: its name in a few words;
- summary: two or three sentences on how it works, in your own words;
- confidence: from 0 to 1, how clearly the post explains it.

List only techniques the post explains. Summarise and cite; never copy the post's text.
